name: Sofia Ramirez
bio:
Sofia Ramirez's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly, fueled by a chance encounter with a local racing team during her university days. Initially drawn to the engineering aspects, she quickly discovered a knack for strategic thinking and problem-solving under pressure. Her analytical mind and ability to anticipate competitors' moves soon made her an invaluable asset.

At Crown Racing, Sofia is known for her meticulous preparation and data-driven approach. She believes in empowering the team with the best possible information, fostering a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement. Her distinctive ability lies in translating complex technical data into actionable strategies, giving her team a competitive edge on the track. Sofia's loyalty is unwavering, and she is determined to guide Crown Racing to the championship title.

physical.description: Sofia is a woman of medium height with a warm, confident demeanor.
